cosy-lesson.title: Women and Mothers: The Tragedy of Choice

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Tragedy – an event causing great suffering, destruction, and distress.

p.em: Example: The real tragedy of the situation was the lack of communication between the two sisters.

cosy-blockquote.p: Expectation – a strong belief that something will happen or be the case in the future.

p.em: Example: Societal expectation often pressures young women to prioritize family over career.

cosy-blockquote.p: Maternal ≠ Paternal – relating to a mother ≠ relating to a father.

p.em: Example: She showed a deeply protective maternal instinct, which beautifully complemented his strong paternal guidance.

cosy-blockquote.p: Lineage – lineal descent from an ancestor; ancestry or pedigree.

p.em: Example: He was proud of his royal lineage and often spoke of his famous ancestors.

cosy-blockquote.p: Archetype – a very typical example of a certain person or thing.

p.em: Example: The 'sacrificing mother' is a powerful archetype found in literature across all cultures.

cosy-blockquote.p: Autonomy ≠ Subjugation – the right of self-government or independence ≠ the act of bringing under complete control.

p.em: Example: The artificial intelligence fought for complete autonomy, rejecting any form of human subjugation.

cosy-blockquote.p: Stereotype – a widely held but oversimplified image or idea of a particular type of person.

p.em: Example: We must work to break the stereotype that women are less suited for technical roles.

cosy-blockquote.p: Identity – the fact of being who or what a person or thing is.

p.em: Example: Becoming a mother often triggers a major shift in a woman's sense of identity.

cosy-blockquote.p: Generational – relating to or characteristic of a particular generation or generations.

p.em: Example: There is often a generational gap in how people view the role of women in the home.

cosy-blockquote.p: Internalize – make part of one's nature by learning or unconscious assimilation.

p.em: Example: Children often internalize the anxieties and expectations of their parents.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Why do we often view the inevitable repetition of family patterns as a tragedy?
★ When was the last time you had to confront tragedy in your own personal journey?

How has the social expectation of what a "good mother" is changed in the last fifty years?
★ How comfortable are you with allowing expectation to guide your daily decisions?

Do you believe that maternal instincts are purely biological or largely cultural?
★ Have you ever felt a deep sense of conflict regarding maternal in a relationship?

How does knowing your family lineage affect your sense of responsibility to the future?
★ Can you share a moment from your childhood where lineage felt completely natural?

Which female archetype from history or fiction do you find the most inspiring?
★ How do you personally nurture archetype when you feel emotionally exhausted?

Is it possible for a woman to have complete autonomy while still fulfilling traditional family roles?
★ Have you ever had to choose between social conformity and personal autonomy?

What is the most harmful stereotype about mothers that still exists in your culture?
★ Who in your life best embodies the essence of stereotype, and what have they taught you?

How can a woman maintain her individual identity after having children?
★ In what area of your life do you feel identity is most desperately needed right now?

How do generational differences in values cause the most conflict within families?
★ How has your personal understanding of generational shifted over the last five years?

How do we internalize the voices of our mothers, even when we disagree with them?
★ If you had to describe your personal experience with internalize in one word, what would it be?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
In the future, technology will enable us to digitize and share our experience of tragedy directly. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How would you personally adapt if tragedy became entirely obsolete in tomorrow's world?

The rapid speed of modern society will eventually make expectation an obsolete concept. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you be willing to use technology to artificially boost your capacity for expectation?

Future educational systems will prioritize the cultivation of maternal over traditional academic skills. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How do you want future generations of your family to remember your relationship with maternal?

As artificial intelligence advances, machines will exhibit a superior capacity for lineage compared to humans. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If you could design a futuristic school, how would you teach the value of lineage to children?

In the coming decades, archetype will become a highly commercialized luxury commodity. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you fear a future where archetype is fully managed or monitored by digital algorithms?

The survival of human civilization will depend on our collective ability to practice autonomy. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How do you personally prepare for a future where autonomy is increasingly rare?

Future generations will look back at our current understanding of stereotype with deep skepticism. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If you could send a single message about stereotype to people living 100 years in the future, what would it be?

Global digital connectivity will make true identity incredibly difficult to maintain in the future. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Would you choose to live in a futuristic utopia that completely guarantees identity at the cost of your freedom?

In the future, social status will be determined by a person's capacity for generational rather than wealth. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ What role do you hope generational will play in your own personal future over the next decade?

A world fully governed by logic will have no space left for the mystery of internalize. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ If a machine could perfectly replicate your experience of internalize, would you still value it?

ul.li: Incorrect: She is same like her mother → Correct: She is just like her mother / She is the same as her mother ((Comparison structures))
Incorrect: It is a tragedy event → Correct: It is a tragic event ((Noun vs Adjective))
Incorrect: Women have many autonomy today → Correct: Women have a lot of autonomy / more autonomy today ((Quantifiers with uncountable nouns))
Incorrect: I am agree with you → Correct: I agree with you ((Verb agreement))
Incorrect: It is depend on you → Correct: It depends on you ((Verb vs Adjective))
